data.body: **[P2] Isolate failure-thread startup errors during termination.** `_fail_in_background()` re-raises when `Thread.start()` fails, so one allocation failure exits this loop before remaining callbacks are reported or the bounded drain runs. Every selected job is already marked terminated and will discard its own outcome. `_handle_terminate_hook()` also sets its completion event in `finally`, making subsequent terminate hooks answer immediately despite unfinished reports. Handle startup failures per job, ensure heartbeat cancellation still happens, continue processing the remaining callbacks, and always perform the bounded drain. Cover a single failure-thread startup error with other reports still pending.
